svg.title: Trumpet-profile bell - 17 rings of 4 ply, ø31 to ø126.0mm
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Bessel horn, gamma 0.7, throat ø31 to rim ø126.0mm over 204mm. Each ring is 4 lamination(s) of 3mm ply, 12mm of rise, lapping the ring below by 1.5mm.
